description: Curated upstream repositories OmniStore indexes. `npm run ingest` resolves every entry through the GitHub API, normalises platforms and package types from real release assets, scores them from public signals, and writes data/omnisource-feed.json. Entries that 404 or fail validation are skipped, never guessed. Each entry is also identity-checked: a repo resolving to a different full_name is rejected unless the entry declares "renamed_to": "Owner/repo", and a repo under 100 stars is rejected as a likely name-squat unless the entry sets "allow_low_stars": true.
